_说明: README 插件表的文案覆盖。键为 plugin/ 下的文件名（不含扩展名）。可选字段：zh_name、zh_desc、en_name、en_desc。没写的字段：中文取插件头部的 #!name 与 #!desc 首句；英文回退为中文并在 Actions 日志里给出警告。

Gemini.zh_desc: Google Gemini（网页、App、API、AI Studio）相关域名统一走 `PROXY`
Gemini.en_desc: Routes Google Gemini domains (web, app, API, AI Studio) through `PROXY`

Spotify.zh_desc: Spotify 官方站点、API、音频与图片 CDN、短链统一走 `PROXY`
Spotify.en_desc: Routes Spotify's official sites, API, audio and image CDNs, and short links through `PROXY`

Spotify_premium.zh_desc: 解锁 Spotify Premium 会员（脚本来自 @app2smile，已移植为 Loon 格式）
Spotify_premium.en_desc: Unlocks Spotify Premium (scripts by @app2smile, ported to Loon)

Twitter.zh_desc: Twitter / X（网页、App、图片视频 CDN、短链）统一走 `PROXY`
Twitter.en_desc: Routes Twitter / X (web, app, image and video CDNs, short links) through `PROXY`

douyin_ip.zh_desc: 仅代理承载属地 / 风控判定信号的接口，媒体 CDN 直连
douyin_ip.en_desc: Proxies only the endpoints that carry location and risk-control signals; media CDNs go direct

rednotebook_ip.zh_desc: 仅代理带经纬度参数的推荐接口、设备指纹注册与打点上报接口，媒体 CDN 直连
rednotebook_ip.en_desc: Proxies only the recommendation endpoints carrying coordinates, device-fingerprint registration, and telemetry; media CDNs go direct

weibo.zh_desc: `api.weibo.cn` 走代理；可自定义发博、评论、转发时显示的来源机型（脚本）
weibo.en_name: Weibo Plus: Attribution routing · Source device
weibo.en_desc: Proxies `api.weibo.cn`; lets you customize the device name shown on posts, comments, and reposts (script)

outlook.zh_desc: Microsoft 认证相关域名直连并跳过 MITM，处理登录窗口反复弹出
outlook.en_desc: Sends Microsoft authentication domains direct and skips MITM, fixing sign-in prompts that keep reappearing

blued.zh_desc: 接口、图片、推送域名统一直连，使出口 IP 一致，用于排查登录失效与收不到推送
blued.en_desc: Sends API, image, and push domains direct so the egress IP stays consistent; for troubleshooting lost sessions and missing push notifications
